claims.title: Rare Ising transitions: finite occupation closure, corrected cut and conditional channel flow

quoted_fields.interface: Original periodic Ising model, physical nearest-neighbor heatbath rate one per site, fixed acquired augmented-component core A=C_r, soft source clock kappa, target B={M>=0}, decreasing voltage v, capacity C and core normalizer ZA remain unchanged. Finite occupation tuples are theta4,phi4/R,L8R,(R,r)=(80,5),(200,5),(1000,6),(10000,7). F is a separately proved comparison downset containing A, not a silent replacement for original M5. Mathematical dependencies on earlier core/contour/source interfaces are explicit, without recovering held artifacts.
quoted_fields.failure: Four-tuple exterior occupation is an affirmative completed finite theorem, not a uniform growing-R theorem or a relative-confidence capacity estimate. The core occupation is retained. The old global-cut raw numerical enclosure is invalidated by its quotient-reuse defect; only the corrected edition supports the current numerical claim. The conditional exp(52) candidate does not become adopted capacity or measured runtime merely because internal review and small checks passed. Earlier restricted sectors keep their exact hypotheses. No novel general method, physical implementation, external peer review or complete North Star result is claimed.
